text:
Emma (AcmeCorp): Hey team — our org was charged again for monthly seats even though we uploaded a PO and then voided it yesterday. Invoice INV-2026-045 and charge txn_1H2j3A4. We need a reversal ASAP, finance is breathing down our necks.

Samir (Support): Sorry about that — can you paste the invoice id + last 4 of card? Also, did you cancel seats in the Console or just remove the PO?

Emma (AcmeCorp): Invoice INV-2026-045, txn_1H2j3A4, card **** 4242. We submitted PO PO-8891 and finance voided it at 2026-03-03 14:12 UTC. Seats were NOT manually cancelled — they were expecting the PO flow to prevent charges.

Anya (Billing Ops): Looking. If the PO was voided the system SHOULD NOT have auto-submitted a payment. Pinging billing-bot to pull event history.

billing-bot: webhook.event: charge.captured payload:
```json
{
  "invoice":"INV-2026-045",
  "transaction":"txn_1H2j3A4",
  "status":"captured",
  "amount_cents":120000,
  "captured_at":"2026-03-04T02:04:12Z"
}
```

Anya (Billing Ops): Thanks — system shows a captured charge at 2026-03-04T02:04:12Z. I don't see a prior PO-void event before capture in the timeline; sounds like a race between the PO state change and the autopay retry.

Mike (Finance): If it's an accidental renewal / double-billing we can issue a refund + credit note. For amounts > $50k we need approval, but $1,200 is fine.

Samir (Support): Emma, can you confirm you'd like a full refund + credit note and that seats should remain cancelled?

Emma (AcmeCorp): Yes please refund and keep seats cancelled. Also confirm auto-renew is turned off on our account.

Anya (Billing Ops): Refund initiated for txn_1H2j3A4, refund id rfd_93kL8. Created credit note CN-7890 for $1,200. Auto-renew disabled on acct acme-1001. Expect funds back in 3-7 business days. Apologies for the disruption :pray: 

Emma (AcmeCorp): Thanks — appreciated. Please send the refund receipt and credit note to finance@acme.com so they can reconcile.

Samir (Support): Noted — forwarding receipt & CN to finance@acme.com now. I'll close the thread once finance confirms receipt.

Emma (AcmeCorp): Received confirmation email from finance. All good on our end. :thumbsup:
